accepted_gaps.title: Narrative cascade lacks a registered causal comparison
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Compare direct, mediated, and interaction models under shared uncertainty.

accepted_gaps.title: Feeding opportunity is not equivalent to realized energy gain
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Separate neck reach, dental wear/replacement, and resource proxies.

accepted_gaps.title: Functional consequences of pneumaticity remain underidentified
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Treat pneumaticity as a proxy and test competing structural, respiratory, and thermal paths.

accepted_gaps.title: Fossil uncertainty can mimic mechanistic support
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Propagate mass, age, coding, time, and sampling uncertainty.

accepted_gaps.title: Trait timing is needed to distinguish prerequisite from correlate
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Require temporal and phylogenetic precedence checks.

accepted_gaps.title: Interaction models need external predictive tests
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Use leave-clade-out prediction and neutral alternative models.

rejected_overclaims: A single environmental variable caused sauropod gigantism.
Pneumatic vertebrae prove a particular metabolic rate or heat-loss mechanism.
Long neck length proves browsing at treetops in every taxon.
A fitted retrospective model establishes historical causation without temporal and comparative checks.
